used_when: voice_config ota_url is set (our own DRADUCK voice server); the default DRADUCK wake word

trainer.name: livekit-wakeword
trainer.note: Same commit and frontends as xiaoya.onnx. Steps after augmentation were run by draduck_wakeword/train_steps.py, because run_extraction needs SessionOptions at this commit.

data.positives: ねえ、ドラダック (also ねえドラダック, ねぇ, ！？, どらだっく) from OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, 13 voices x 12 styles, and 9 macOS Japanese voices, at 0.85-1.26x; kept only clips SenseVoice hears as ね…ドラダック and no longer than 1.85 s (training end-aligns positives in the 2 s window); 2810 train / 534 test, test voices held out (verse, cedar, Sandy)
data.negatives: the short word's 40 near misses plus 26 more (ドラダック alone, ねえ, ねえねえ, ねえ、ドラマ / トラック / ママ…), about 400 everyday and 90 ねえ… sentences; 8402 train / 1466 test; plus ACAV100M features, MUSAN noise, MIT room impulse responses

evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_13: Luwu wakeword_manager code on the shared cached audio: at 0.5-0.7, ねえ、ドラダック 30/30, ドラダック alone 30/30, 0 false wakes in 7.6 min family talk and 3.8 min packed near misses
evaluation.note: Wakes on ドラダック alone too: the trainer centres negatives, so a centred ドラダック never looks like the end of the phrase.
evaluation.not_yet: real voices (adults, children) through the duck's own microphone
evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_24: same code and audio at 0.25-0.5: ねえ、ドラダック 30/30 and ドラダック alone 30/30 at every threshold; false wakes 0 in 7.6 min family talk at all; in 3.8 min packed near misses 1 at 0.25 and 0.30 (heard as 空をラックシュフートが), 0 at 0.35 and above
evaluation.real_voice_2026_11_24: a Mandarin-speaking tester's 「ねえ、ドラダック」 on the lab duck (webcam microphone, input gain 12 dB): live peaks 0.14, 0.17, 0.20, 0.29, 0.42, 0.51; a 60 s take of three tries on the duck's microphone (about 10 dB above room noise, no clipping) scored 0.49, 0.33, 0.35, and SenseVoice heard them as Chinese and Korean words, not as the phrase; the synthetic test clip played from a phone 0.90-0.97. Threshold lowered from 0.5 to 0.35, then 0.30; the lasting fix is real and varied voices in training
